cases.treatment: The storefront organizes the main navigation by product category, sorts the catalog with full-price items first, and labels each item with its current list price.

cases.control: The gift certificate is valid for three weeks from issue.
cases.treatment: The same gift certificate is valid for two months from issue.

cases.control: The referrer earns a fixed reward of a stated point value for a successful referral.

cases.control: The referred friend earns a fixed reward of a stated point value when they accept a referral.
cases.treatment: The referred friend earns a variable reward of the same expected value when they accept a referral, awarded as a stated chance at a larger point value.

cases.treatment: Product images are presented at a single fixed display size.
